title: promote-latest must stay in its own fixed concurrency group, gated before it queues
answers: canonical release never got its latest docker tag after a patch release ran
pending latest promotion was replaced by another workflow run
concurrency group for the docker promotion job
why is the latest check a separate job
body:
Invariant: the floating-tag promotion must not share a concurrency group with runs that will skip promotion.
Enforced at .github/workflows/push-images.yml:promote-latest (group `push-images-promote-latest`, `cancel-in-progress: false`, job-level `if: needs.check-latest.outputs.promote == 'true'`).
What breaks: GitHub keeps one pending run per concurrency group and replaces it when a new run queues, even with `cancel-in-progress: false`. If a non-latest release's run replaces a pending canonical promotion and then skips, no job promotes the canonical release and the floating tags stay stale.
Keep the `check-latest` decision in its own job, and keep the concurrency block off `push-images` and `check-latest`. The Latest re-check inside `promote-latest` must still run before the `imagetools create` writes.
applies: Any job added to push-images.yml that writes floating image tags or uses a concurrency group.
says: The latest container image tag did not update after publishing a new canonical release.
Releasing an older patch version left the main Docker release tag pointing to stale builds.
Ensure floating image tags always point to the most recent canonical version.
Concurrent image publishing runs cancel the promotion of our latest release tag.
search: Floating Docker image tag promotions in .github/workflows/push-images.yml must isolate promote-latest inside its own fixed concurrency group gated by a prior check-latest job. The promote-latest job uses group push-images-promote-latest with cancel-in-progress set to false and executes only when needs.check-latest.outputs.promote equals true. Keeping check-latest in an ungated separate job prevents skipped runs from canceling pending canonical promotions, and a final re-check must precede imagetools create writes.
